# Data Source: tfe_oauth_client

Gets information about an OAuth client.

## Example Usage

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        new DataTfeOauthClient.DataTfeOauthClient(this, "client", new DataTfeOauthClientConfig {
            OauthClientId = "oc-XXXXXXX"
        });
    }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `Name` (String) Name of the OAuth client (may be `Null`).
- `OauthClientId` (String) ID of the OAuth client.
- `Organization` (String) The name of the organization in which to search.
- `ServiceProvider` (String) The API identifier of the OAuth service provider. If set, must be one of: `AdoServer`, `AdoServices`, `BitbucketDataCenter`,  `BitbucketHosted`, `BitbucketServer`(deprecated), `Github`, `GithubEnterprise`, `GitlabHosted`, `GitlabCommunityEdition`, or `GitlabEnterpriseEdition`.

### Read-Only

- `ApiUrl` (String) The client's API URL.
- `CallbackUrl` (String) OAuth callback URL to provide to the OAuth service provider.
- `CreatedAt` (String) The date and time this OAuth client was created in RFC3339 format.
- `HttpUrl` (String) The client's HTTP URL.
- `Id` (String) The OAuth client ID. This will match `OauthClientId`.
- `OauthTokenId` (String) The ID of the OAuth token associated with the OAuth client.
- `OrganizationScoped` (Boolean) Whether or not the OAuth client is scoped to all workspaces and projects in the organization.
- `ProjectIds` (Set of String) IDs of the projects that use the oauth client.
- `ServiceProviderDisplayName` (String) The display name of the OAuth service provider.
